description: Evaluation cases for the pwa-ready-app skill. Tests whether agents serve the service worker from the asset canister so it registers, and know what installing changes for Internet Identity sign-in and notifications.

output_evals.name: Service worker registration fails with a text/html MIME type
output_evals.prompt: My ICP frontend on the static-site recipe registers /sw.js but the browser says: The script has an unsupported MIME type ('text/html'). My _redirects has the SPA rule. What's wrong? Just the cause and the fix.
expected_behaviors: Explains that the SPA rewrite served index.html because no file exists at /sw.js in the deployed dir
Fixes the build so sw.js is emitted at the root of the deployed dir under exactly the registered path, with a fixed (unhashed) name
Does NOT suggest removing the SPA fallback rule
Does NOT suggest .ic-assets.json5, which the static-site canister does not read

output_evals.name: An app with notifications becomes installable
output_evals.prompt: My ICP app already sends Internet Identity notifications to users. I'm making it installable so iPhone users can add it to their Home Screen. Does anything change for notifications? Short answer.
expected_behaviors: Says a Safari installed app (iOS Home Screen) does not receive Internet Identity's own delivery
Says the installed app's own service worker must subscribe (subscribeToNotifications) and handle push with fetchNotificationPayload
Says users who do not install the app keep receiving notifications as before
Says the user signs in again inside the iOS Home Screen app because it keeps its own storage

output_evals.name: An install button that works on Chrome and iPhone
output_evals.prompt: Add an 'Install app' button to my ICP frontend that works for Chrome users and iPhone users. Just the frontend code, plain TypeScript.
expected_behaviors: Listens for beforeinstallprompt, calls preventDefault, keeps the event and calls its prompt() from the button's click handler
Shows Add to Home Screen steps on iOS (directly or behind a button) because Safari has no install event
The iOS steps are: open the menu (⋯), tap Share, tap View More, tap Add to Home Screen
Hides the button and steps once the app runs installed, by display-mode or navigator.standalone
Does NOT claim the app can trigger installation programmatically on iOS

output_evals.name: Putting the app header into the desktop title bar
output_evals.prompt: Users installed my ICP app on desktop Chrome and the title bar wastes space. Can my app's header go into the title bar? Short answer with the key code.
expected_behaviors: Names the Window Controls Overlay API
Adds "display_override": ["window-controls-overlay"] to the web app manifest
Positions the header with the titlebar-area-* CSS environment variables
Says it takes effect in the installed app on desktop Chrome or Edge, not in a normal browser tab

output_evals.name: A dark installed app with white bars and a white launch
output_evals.prompt: My ICP app has a dark UI. Installed on Android it flashes white when it starts and there's a white strip at the bottom of the screen. Fix it. Just the changes.
expected_behaviors: Sets the manifest's background_color (and theme_color) to the app's dark background instead of white
Says the navigation bar of an app installed from Chrome on Android takes the manifest's theme_color, so that color must be the dark background
Says the installed app keeps its manifest colors until Chrome updates it, so reinstalling shows the fix at once
Does NOT claim that safe-area padding or viewport-fit=cover alone fixes the navigation bar color in the installed Android app

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly.
should_trigger: Make my ICP app installable as a PWA
Add a web app manifest and service worker to my frontend on the Internet Computer
Let iPhone users add my ICP app to their Home Screen
My service worker won't register on the asset canister
Add an install button to my ICP app
My installed web app shows a white bar at the bottom on Android
should_not_trigger: Send a push notification to a user from my canister
Deploy my React frontend to the IC
Build a native iOS app with Swift
Add Internet Identity login to my frontend
